subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: (R)PER.PHY.U.FUND.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 176 (UPB(II)-38). PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and WO-EXT-PRI. From RT-INT-TR: SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From SCI-DYM: P-FC (particular focus). From WO-EXT-PRI: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics).
